title: The spectrum of a finite ring map is a finite morphism
statement: Let $\varphi:A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings which is finite, i.e. $B$ is a finitely generated $A$-module via $\varphi$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then the induced morphism of schemes $\operatorname{Spec}\varphi:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] (and conversely, if $\operatorname{Spec}\varphi$ is finite then $\varphi$ is finite).
